extracted.name: Bread and Rolls the Yeast type
extracted.description: An easy bread to make. Weather, humidity, and temperature, can effect baking process.
ingredient_lines: 6 cups all-purpose flour plus more to dust with if needed
As needed oil to coat bowl and cover dough
instruction_lines: Add the warm water, oil, yeast, salt, and sugar to a large bowl. Mix well. Allow to bloom. The yeast mixture will turn frothy.

Add oil to a large bowl and get oil on the sides, when oiled set aside. Add the flour to the yeast mixture stir gently till mixed. Add extra flour if to sticky. Knead for 5 minutes. Add the dough to the oiled bowl. Cover allow to rise. About an hour maybe a bit longer.

Preheat oven 350° Fahrenheit. Punch in middle. Let rise again. Form how you like it makes several loaves or rolls. Bake for an hour. Butter tops and allow to brown tops. Allow to cool a bit serve I hope you enjoy!!!
